mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which can be worsened by ranitidine's effects on electrolyte absorption, and both drugs may contribute to QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; consider alternative H2-blocker or proton pump inhibitor if electrolyte depletion occurs; assess QT interval if other risk factors present.
